## Expected and actual behavior

## Reproduction

Forge version/commit, runtime/OS, analyzer version, source revision and workspace freshness. Use a synthetic or authorized public example. Do not attach private source, credentials, or private graph outputs.

## Impact

Wrong locator, stale context, missing/incorrect relationship, privacy concern, or another failure. Report sensitive security details privately as described in SECURITY.md.
